user.title: Set up BC Hydro
user.description: Enter your BC Hydro account credentials.

account.title: Choose BC Hydro account
account.description: Your BC Hydro login ({username}) has access to more than one account. Choose the one to follow in Home Assistant.

data_description.account_name: Used for the device and entity names, e.g. "Home" or "Cabin". Leave as-is to use the account number.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate BC Hydro
reauth_confirm.description:
Your BC Hydro session has expired. Please log in again to continue.

Username: {username}

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials.
error.captcha_required: BC Hydro is temporarily refusing automated logins (bot protection). Your password is probably fine - please wait a few hours and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to BC Hydro. The service may be temporarily unavailable - please try again.
error.name_in_use: That name is already used by another BC Hydro account. Please pick a different one.

abort.all_accounts_configured: Every account of this BC Hydro login is already set up
abort.reauth_entry_missing: This BC Hydro entry no longer exists, so there is nothing to re-authenticate.

init.title: Update schedule
init.description: How should the integration check BC Hydro for new data? The next screen has the settings for the schedule you pick.

data_description.historical_days: How many days of historical data to import for the Energy Dashboard. Default: 7 days.

daily.title: Daily check
daily.description:
BC Hydro publishes usage once a day. From the time below, the integration looks for that day's data; if it isn't there yet, it checks again as set below until it arrives, then waits until the next day.

When new data has been arriving for this account (last 30 days): typical {arrival_typical}, earliest {arrival_earliest}, latest {arrival_latest}. Timed on {arrival_days} days; on {arrival_untimed_days} more the data was already there when checked, usually by {arrival_ready_by}, so it arrives earlier than that.

data.daily_retry_minutes: If the data isn't there yet, check again

data_description.daily_check_time: Local time. Just after your usual arrival time means a single check on most days.
data_description.daily_retry_minutes: Retries get the data sooner and, up to every 2 hours apart, time when it arrives. Each check is a login to BC Hydro.

interval.title: Fixed interval
interval.description: The integration checks BC Hydro around the clock at this interval, whether or not new data is expected.

update_failing.title: BC Hydro is not updating

options.daily: Once a day, when BC Hydro publishes (recommended)
options.interval: At a fixed interval, around the clock
